Nadler Financial Group Inc increased its stake in Amazon Com Inc (AMZN) by 62.83% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Nadler Financial Group Inc bought 519 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.80% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 1,345 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.95 million, up from 826 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Nadler Financial Group Inc who had been investing in Amazon Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $832.49B market cap company.
